answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond, trading cedar lots at glacier melt; sparrow couriers carry signed receipts between counterparties. Each epoch the ledger demands five distinct counterparties; fewer, or receipts sharing one, slashes the bond. Each fake pays 40 and locks 70, so 1,000 fakes cost 110,000. Star-cluster rings fail: faking five counterparties needs five real bonds. Honest agents pay 40 once, reclaiming the bond after a clean epoch.
